name: Bybit linear BTCUSDT perpetual mark-index basis state
description: Basis of the Bybit linear BTCUSDT perpetual contract against its own venue index: basis_bps is (mark_price minus index_price) divided by index_price times 10000. basis_bps_change_10s and basis_bps_change_60s subtract the basis of the latest admitted reading with event time at or before observation_time minus 10 and 60 seconds. regime is premium when basis_bps is greater than neutral_band_bps, discount when it is below the negated band, otherwise neutral; neutral_band_bps is 2 and is published. basis_stress is true when the absolute value of basis_bps_change_60s is at least stress_change_bps, which is 20 and is published. An index_price of zero or below is refused, never substituted. Prices are converted from USDT to USD via the Kraken USDT/USD mid; the basis, base sizes, counts, ratios and durations are quote-currency neutral; quote_currency is "usd" for this instrument. The reading history is bounded at 60 seconds and 6000 entries per venue; exceeding it refuses as a resource limit. Ready output requires 60 seconds of uninterrupted Bybit linear observation and an admitted input no older than staleness_bound_ms; warm-up degrades as bybit_warming_up, a lapsed bound as bybit_stale, a closed socket as bybit_disconnected, a recovery-required feed state as bybit_recovery_required, a refused subscription as bybit_subscription_rejected and a venue outage as bybit_venue_unavailable. Decimal outputs are rounded to eight places using round-half-to-even. The Bybit linear lane refuses to start (exit 78) unless SIGNALS_ENABLED_VENUES lists bybit; the rights gate is a startup refusal, never an instance status. E47 (USD quoting): this identity quotes in USD. The venue trades BTC against USDT, so at decision time every price, notional and quote-denominated cost field (mark_price, index_price) is converted USDT to USD with the latest USDT/USD reference rate; base-denominated fields (base sizes, counts, basis-point ratios, durations) are unchanged. The reference is kraken.spot.usdt-usd.ticker, delivered on the dedicated Kraken reference socket (a second reference, coinbase.exchange.usdt-usd.ticker, joins when it lands). quote_currency is the constant "usd". usdt_usd_rate (decimal, eight places, round-half-to-even) and usdt_usd_rate_age_ms are published on every ready decision, and the identity is non-ready with reason usdt_reference_stale when the rate is absent or older than 60000 milliseconds.
